moments.author: Deion Sanders
moments.quote: “We rushed for 183 yards, my god. They rushed for 51. I thought we were small.”
moments.why: His postgame clap‑back after Colorado’s upset win immediately went viral, flipping the narrative on critics.

moments.author: Deion Sanders
moments.quote: He’s my son… I’m a real loving, caring father, and that’s my son.
moments.why: The heartfelt moment seeing his son Shedeur on the sideline after the win struck a chord widely shared online.

moments.author: Deion Sanders
moments.quote: I'm glad Julian Lewis came alive because the media would've ate him alive.
moments.why: His raw defense of freshman QB Julian Lewis amid intense media scrutiny has become a defining viral quote.

moments.author: Pastor E. Dewey Smith
moments.quote: Let me challenge you. Sometimes we say stuff like let your haters be your motivators.
moments.why: His role as Coach Prime’s newly titled “Empowerment Coach” and this motivational speech sparked social chatter.

moments.author: DNVR Buffs
moments.quote: “We will be aware of wherever he’s gonna lineup…” about Georgia Tech RB Justice Haynes.
moments.why: A preview of Coach Prime’s bold presser remarks went viral ahead of the season opener.
